entities.summary: Liang, a notable figure in the history of Brunei, associated with Po-ni Kingdom and Indianized Polity (518–977). Preceded by First recorded embassy from Po-ni to China's Liang dynasty. Their legacy influenced Hindu-Buddhist Influences and Srivijayan Connections and Po-ni sends tribute to the Song dynasty, indicating continued diplomatic ties.
